source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps all senders and the community's twofold location.
verses.before: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.after: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.tsw_comparator: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.rationale: Preserves the paired gift and two named sources.
verses.before: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Keeps obligation, abundant growth and every-member mutual love.
verses.before: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, as is fitting, because your trust is growing greatly and the love of each one of you for one another is increasing.
verses.after: We ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters, as is right, because your faith is growing abundantly and the love each one of you has for one another is increasing.
verses.tsw_comparator: We ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters, as is fitting, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing.

verses.rationale: Retains corporate boasting and the full scope of suffering.
verses.before: Therefore we ourselves boast about you among God’s churches because of your endurance and trust in all your persecutions and the afflictions you are bearing.
verses.after: Therefore, we ourselves boast about you among God's churches because of your endurance and faith in all the persecutions and afflictions you bear.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore we ourselves boast about you among the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith in all your persecutions and afflictions that you are enduring.

verses.rationale: Keeps suffering connected to the evaluative claim without calling suffering itself good.
verses.before: This is evidence of God’s righteous judgment, so that you may be considered worthy of God’s kingdom, for which you are also suffering.
verses.after: This is evidence of God's righteous judgment, so that you may be considered worthy of God's kingdom, for which you also suffer.
verses.tsw_comparator: This is evidence of the righteous judgment of God, that you may be considered worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering,

verses.rationale: Preserves the letter's retributive claim and repeated affliction wording.
verses.before: For it is righteous with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
verses.after: Indeed, it is just for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
verses.tsw_comparator: since indeed it is just for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

verses.rationale: Keeps relief, solidarity and the public heavenly revelation.
verses.before: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels
verses.after: and to give relief to you who are afflicted, along with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his powerful angels
verses.tsw_comparator: and to grant relief to you who are afflicted, as well as to us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

verses.rationale: Retains fire, vengeance/justice and both described groups.
verses.before: in flaming fire, bringing judgment on those who do not know God and those who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
verses.after: in flaming fire, bringing justice on those who do not know God and who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps punishment language and the debated away-from relation without softening duration.
verses.before: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lord’s presence and from the glory of his might,
verses.after: They will pay the penalty of eternal destruction away from the Lord's presence and from the glory of his might,
verses.tsw_comparator: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his power,

verses.rationale: Preserves the day's two purposes and the community's response.
verses.before: when he comes on that day to be glorified among his holy ones and marveled at among all who trusted—because our testimony to you was trusted.
verses.after: when he comes on that day to be glorified among his saints and marveled at among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
verses.tsw_comparator: when he comes on that day to be glorified in his holy ones and to be marveled at among all who have believed—because our testimony to you was believed.

verses.rationale: Keeps worthiness, divine power and both good intention and action.
verses.before: For this reason we always pray for you, that our God may consider you worthy of the calling and fulfill every desire for goodness and every work of trust with power,
verses.after: With this in view, we always pray for you, that our God may consider you worthy of his calling and powerfully fulfill every desire for goodness and every work of faith,
verses.tsw_comparator: To this end we always pray for you, that our God may make you worthy of his calling and fulfill every resolve for good and every work of faith by his power,

verses.rationale: Retains reciprocal glorification and the dense final attribution.
verses.before: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Keeps the two linked future events and communal appeal.
verses.before: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, brothers and sisters, we ask you
verses.after: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered together to him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,

verses.rationale: Preserves three alleged channels, false attribution and the pinned day title.
verses.before: not to be quickly shaken from your mind or alarmed, whether by a spirit, a spoken message, or a letter supposedly from us, claiming that the Lord’s day has arrived.
verses.after: not to be quickly shaken from your senses or alarmed, whether by a spirit, a spoken message or a letter supposedly from us, claiming that the day of the Lord has already arrived.
verses.tsw_comparator: not to be quickly shaken in mind or alarmed, either by a spirit or a word or a letter as though from us, to the effect that the day of the Lord has come.

verses.rationale: Retains the supplied future logic, rebellion and pinned lawlessness reading.
verses.before: Let no one deceive you in any way. For that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,
verses.after: Do not let anyone deceive you in any way. That day will not come unless the rebellion comes first and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let no one deceive you in any way; for that day will not come unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the son of destruction,

verses.rationale: Keeps sweeping self-exaltation, temple action and blasphemous claim.
verses.before: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God’s temple, presenting himself as God.
verses.after: He opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he seats himself in God's temple, presenting himself as God.
verses.tsw_comparator: who opposes and exalts himself above every so-called god or object of worship, so that he takes his seat in the temple of God, declaring himself to be God.

verses.rationale: Preserves the corrective rhetorical question and prior oral teaching.
verses.before: Do you not remember that while I was still with you I kept telling you these things?
verses.after: Do you not remember that I told you these things while I was still with you?
verses.tsw_comparator: Do you not remember that when I was still with you I was telling you these things?

verses.rationale: Keeps the restrainer unnamed and the timing purpose.
verses.before: And now you know what restrains him so that he may be revealed in his own time.
verses.after: And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed at his own time.
verses.tsw_comparator: And now you know what restrains him, so that he may be revealed in his time.

verses.rationale: Retains the shift from neuter restraint to a personal restrainer without identifying either.
verses.before: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains it will do so until he is out of the way.
verses.after: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one now restraining it will continue until he is out of the way.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the mystery of lawlessness is already at work; only the one who now restrains it will do so until he is taken out of the way.

verses.rationale: Keeps lethal judgment, breath image and doubled manifestation language.
verses.before: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will destroy with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
verses.after: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.
verses.tsw_comparator: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will kill with the breath of his mouth and bring to nothing by the appearance of his coming.

verses.rationale: Preserves the parallel coming and counterfeit power triad.
verses.before: The lawless one’s coming is according to Satan’s working, with every kind of power, false signs and wonders,
verses.after: The lawless one's coming is in accordance with Satan's activity, with every kind of power, false signs and wonders,
verses.tsw_comparator: The coming of the lawless one is by the activity of Satan with all power and signs and false wonders,

verses.rationale: Keeps culpable refusal and salvation purpose.
verses.before: and every kind of unrighteous deception among those who are perishing, because they did not welcome the love of the truth so that they might be saved.
verses.after: and with every wicked deception for those who are perishing, because they did not welcome the love of the truth so as to be saved.
verses.tsw_comparator: and with all deception of unrighteousness for those who are perishing, because they did not receive the love of the truth so as to be saved.

verses.rationale: Retains divine agency in the difficult judgment claim.
verses.before: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they trust the lie,
verses.after: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion, so that they believe the lie,
verses.tsw_comparator: And for this reason God sends them a working of delusion so that they may believe what is false,

verses.rationale: Keeps both disbelief and moral delight as grounds.
verses.before: so that all may be judged who did not trust the truth but delighted in unrighteousness.
verses.after: so that all who did not believe the truth but delighted in unrighteousness may be judged.
verses.tsw_comparator: in order that all may be judged who did not believe the truth but took pleasure in unrighteousness.

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned firstfruits reading and retains both means.
verses.before: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through holiness by the Spirit and trust in the truth.
verses.after: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers and sisters loved by the Lord, because God chose you as firstfruits for salvation through the Spirit's sanctifying work and faith in the truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: But we ought always to give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters beloved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification by the Spirit and belief in the truth,

verses.rationale: Keeps call, proclaimed means and glory as goal.
verses.before: He called you to this through our good news, so that you might obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: He called you to this through our good news, so that you may obtain the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: to which he called you through our good news, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Preserves stability, transmitted teaching and both media.
verses.before: Therefore, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold to the traditions you were taught, whether by our spoken word or by our letter.
verses.after: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions you were taught, whether by our spoken word or by our letter.
verses.tsw_comparator: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the traditions that you were taught, whether by word or by our letter.

verses.rationale: Keeps the compound subject and the two grace-gifts.
verses.before: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal encouragement and good hope by grace,
verses.after: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

verses.rationale: Completes the blessing with inward encouragement and outward stability.
verses.before: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good work and word.
verses.after: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good work and word.
verses.tsw_comparator: comfort your hearts and strengthen them in every good work and word.

verses.rationale: Retains the running image and the Thessalonians as precedent.
verses.before: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us so that the Lord’s word may run and be glorified, just as it was among you,
verses.after: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us, that the Lord's word may run swiftly and be honored, just as it was among you,
verses.tsw_comparator: Finally, brothers and sisters, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may run and be glorified, just as it did among you,

verses.rationale: Keeps danger concrete and the explanatory wordplay on faithfulness/faith.
verses.before: and that we may be rescued from wicked and evil people, because not everyone has trust.
verses.after: and that we may be rescued from perverse and evil people, for not everyone has faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: and that we may be delivered from wicked and evil people; for not all have faith.

verses.rationale: Preserves the contrast, stability and personal/impersonal ambiguity of evil.
verses.before: But the Lord is faithful. He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
verses.after: But the Lord is faithful; he will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the Lord is faithful, who will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

verses.rationale: Keeps present and future obedience under qualified confidence.
verses.before: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
verses.after: We are confident in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will continue to do what we command.
verses.tsw_comparator: And we have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things we command.

verses.rationale: Retains two ambiguous genitives rather than resolving whose love or endurance.
verses.before: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and Christ’s endurance.
verses.after: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's endurance.
verses.tsw_comparator: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God and into the steadfastness of Christ.

verses.rationale: Keeps strong authority, communal distance and the conduct standard.
verses.before: We command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother or sister who lives disorderly and not according to the tradition they received from us.
verses.after: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from every brother or sister who lives disorderly and not according to the tradition received from us.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now we command you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you keep away from every brother or sister walking disorderly and not according to the tradition that you received from us.

verses.rationale: Preserves appeal to example and repeated disorder language.
verses.before: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not disorderly among you,
verses.after: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us: we were not disorderly among you,
verses.tsw_comparator: For you yourselves know how you ought to imitate us, because we were not idle among you,

verses.rationale: Keeps payment, manual effort and reason.
verses.before: nor did we eat anyone’s bread without paying. Instead, with labor and hardship we worked night and day so that we would not burden any of you.
verses.after: nor did we eat anyone's bread without paying. Instead, with labor and hardship we worked night and day so that we would not burden any of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: nor did we eat anyone’s bread without paying for it, but with labor and toil we worked night and day, so that we might not burden any of you.

verses.rationale: Retains renounced authority and pedagogical purpose.
verses.before: It was not because we do not have the right, but so that we might give you ourselves as an example to imitate.
verses.after: It was not because we lack the right, but so that we might offer ourselves as an example for you to imitate.
verses.tsw_comparator: It was not because we do not have authority, but to give you in ourselves an example to imitate.

verses.rationale: Preserves unwillingness rather than inability and the quoted command.
verses.before: For even when we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is not willing to work, that person should not eat.
verses.after: Even when we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, that person should not eat.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For even when we were with you, we gave you this command: if anyone is not willing to work, neither let him eat.

verses.rationale: Keeps the Greek wordplay between working and busy interference.
verses.before: For we hear that some among you are living disorderly, not working at all but meddling in other people’s affairs.
verses.after: For we hear that some among you live disorderly, not working at all but meddling in others' work.
verses.tsw_comparator: For we hear that some among you are walking disorderly, not working at all, but being busybodies.

verses.rationale: Retains both authority and appeal, quiet labor and self-support.
verses.before: We command and urge such people in the Lord Jesus Christ to work quietly and eat their own bread.
verses.after: We command and urge such people in the Lord Jesus Christ to work quietly and eat their own bread.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to work quietly and eat their own bread.

verses.rationale: Keeps the contrasting communal encouragement.
verses.before: But you, brothers and sisters, do not grow weary in doing good.
verses.after: But you, brothers and sisters, do not grow weary in doing good.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you, brothers and sisters, do not grow weary in doing good.

verses.rationale: Preserves social discipline and its stated corrective aim.
verses.before: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely with them, so that they may be ashamed.
verses.after: If anyone does not obey our word in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate closely, so that the person may feel ashamed.
verses.tsw_comparator: And if anyone does not obey what we say in this letter, take note of that person and do not associate with him, so that he may be put to shame.

verses.rationale: Keeps the limit on discipline and familial identity.
verses.before: Yet do not regard that person as an enemy; warn them as a brother or sister.
verses.after: Yet do not regard that person as an enemy, but warn them as a brother or sister.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother or sister.

verses.rationale: Retains emphatic giver, exhaustive scope and inclusive presence.
verses.before: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
verses.after: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in every way. The Lord be with you all.

verses.rationale: Preserves autograph claim and authentication function.
verses.before: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. This is the sign in every letter; this is how I write.
verses.after: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. This is the sign in every letter; this is how I write.
verses.tsw_comparator: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the mark in every letter of mine; this is how I write.

verses.rationale: Retains the final inclusive blessing.
verses.before: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
verses.after: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
